column2: Yeah... I agree with you there.{wait}{clear}You might think it's not like me, but even someone like me feels calm once I'm inside...{wait}{clear}And yet...
Debts
Do you have debts?
Shut up! That's none of your business, is it?!
Why so much...?
You don't give up...{wait}{clear}A lot happened... A lot...{wait}{clear}I felt like I couldn't go on without fooling around. That's all.
Um... I'm just worried about you, Rocus...
If you're going to say you're worried, mind your own business.{wait}{clear}I just did what I wanted, and it was before I met you.{wait}{clear}So could you drop this subject now?
Is there something else?
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't tired. I never imagined I'd go out traveling like this.{wait}{clear}But it's nice, walking around outside like this.
You should do that once in a while!{wait}{clear}Floating around all the time is kind of unfair, you know.
Yeah... Usually I'd sit up in the tower with the wind blowing on me.{wait}{clear}The wind smells different now that I'm walking like this.
Rough roads are hard, and I'm not good with them, but I can't complain, can I?{wait}{clear}Unless I didn't have to take your requests, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.
How rude! I may not look it, but my sense of direction is perfect.{wait}{clear}Besides, even if I get a little lost, Vesta will help me.

Yeah... You're right... The sunset you can see from the tower is so beautiful.{wait}{clear}The southern coast of Bremes Isle turns bright red, and then slowly turns purple... The sky has so many faces, doesn't it?
Yeah. I'd hardly ever left Bremes Isle, so it all feels so fresh.
Yeah, I think they're working hard.{wait}{clear}At first I thought they'd be a nuisance. And they startled Vesta, too. Lots of funny things happened.
Yeah, I think about all kinds of things. Things I never felt or never knew back in the tower, I'm understanding more and more...{wait}{clear}Before I know it, I'm just spacing out...
Sorry, but I don't really like meeting people. It's such a hassle, isn't it?
I hope so... More importantly, I'm really sleepy, so go home soon, okay?
You came all the way here to say that? You angels really are considerate.{wait}{clear}But thanks.

You ask weird things, as always.{wait}{clear}Well, I don't like it or dislike it, I guess... Sometimes I stay up reading grimoires, and Vesta's nocturnal, too.{wait}{clear}But I do like napping somewhere nice and warm.
Thanks.{wait}{clear}Really, so much happens every day, it's kind of a lot...
Nothing really... Oh, I check whether Vesta's come back before I go to sleep.
Hmm, I'm not good at it, but I can't complain, can I?{wait}{clear}But I think I've gotten pretty used to it.
I space out, or read a book... If it's clear, I look at the stars, I guess.{wait}{clear}I don't worry about not sleeping much. Some magic works best at night, and I learn a lot.
Yeah... When I remember it sometimes, it does get a little hard...{wait}{clear}That's not like me, huh? Don't mind it.
I don't mind... I'm sleepy, though...
Another weird question. Well, it's very you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄, so fine.{wait}{clear}Let's see... I change, I wash my face... Hey, is that enough? Satisfied?
Yeah, there's a bit more I want to look into and try out.{wait}{clear}Hey, ＄＄＄＄＄＄! If you came to bother me, go home.
What are you saying all of a sudden? Besides... it's not like I'm doing it just for you.
I'm not swinging swords around or anything, so it's not that hard.{wait}{clear}It's hard when my spells keep failing, I guess.
I'm totally fine.{wait}{clear}But if you keep chattering, I'll get distracted and it won't be training anymore.{wait}{clear}Be quiet, okay?
You think so...? I like studying magic, so maybe that's why it looks that way.
Well, compared to people who fight with swords and stuff, I don't have much stamina, but using magic is hard work too.{wait}{clear}So if anything, I'm confident in my mental strength.
What are you saying? I don't carry weapons, so I'm fine.{wait}{clear}Well, sometimes magic does backfire in all sorts of ways.
Yeah... Let's see... How well I can raise my mental strength and use my power in balance, I guess.{wait}{clear}I think balance is key to magic. I try not to do anything reckless.
Yeah, not bad, I guess.
Yeah, that's right. It's way more fun when a spell works.
